content.text:
I'm trying to figure out which shape is on top by checking which regions aren't occluded, tracing through the grid coordinates for shapes 6 and 8 to see where their rectangles overlap.

Working through it, 8 seems to occlude 6, while 4 appears to occlude 8 since 4's column covers the exact cells missing from 8's bounding box. But then 4's own bounding box has missing cells too that aren't explained by any overlap, so 4 might not be a complete rectangular shape either — I need to reconsider which shape sits at the very top of the stack.

So checking further: 3's missing cells align with where 4 sits on top of it, and 4 itself has no missing cells explained by another shape, meaning 4 is the topmost, fully visible shape, with bounding box rows2-5, cols2-5.
